column1: # Wilderness zones for the route planner (Tiles.wilderness), as kind <tab> x from, x to, y from, y to.
# safe: safe zones in the Wilderness: the Ferox Enclave ("a safe area within the Wilderness", OSRS Wiki, Ferox
# Enclave; CC BY-NC-SA 3.0) and the dungeon under its pub, where the Soul Wars portal is. Their tiles as the collision
# map walks them: from inside the enclave up to its four barriers (Barrier 39652/39653), and from the foot of the
# outside: ground within the Wilderness's bounds that is south of its edge: the strip along the Wilderness Ditch's
# south side (the ditch's line runs along y 3522, OSRS Wiki, Wilderness Ditch) and the Black Knights' Fortress's
# grounds north of that line, which the ditch goes round. The tiles walking reaches from south of the edge without
# crossing the ditch, in the collision map (game cache 2727).
